main.content:
==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:der|fr:maximum<ety:der<la:maximus>>}}
Via {{der|en|fr|-}} from {{der|en|la|maximum}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈmæksɪməm/}}
* {{hyph|en|max|i|mum}}
* {{audio|en|en-uk-maximum.ogg|a=UK}}
* {{audio|en|en-au-maximum.ogg|a=AU}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|maxima|s}}

# The [[high|highest]] [[limit]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1806|author=P. Colquhoun|title=A Treatise on Indigence
|passage=This is the fundamental principle of good legislation. It is the art of conducting a nation to the '''maximum''' of happiness and the minimum of misery}}
# {{lb|en|mathematics}} The [[great]]est [[value]] of a [[set]] or other mathematical structure, especially the [[global maximum]] or a [[local maximum]] of a [[function]].
# {{lb|en|analysis}} An [[upper]] [[bound]] of a set which is also an [[element]] of that set.
# {{lb|en|statistics}} The largest [[value]] of a [[batch]] or [[sample]] or the [[upper]] [[bound]] of a [[probability distribution]].
# {{lb|en|snooker}} A 147 [[break]]; the highest possible break.
#: {{syn|en|147|maximum break}}
# {{lb|en|colloquial|darts}} A [[score]] of [[180]] with three [[dart]]s.
# {{lb|en|colloquial|cricket}} A scoring [[shot]] for 6 [[run]]s.
# {{lb|en|colloquial}} [[maximum security]]

====Usage notes====
* {{m|en|maxima|Maxima}} is the more common plural, especially for the technical senses.

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|max}}

====Antonyms====
* {{l|en|minimum}}

====Hypernyms====
* {{sense|statistics}} {{l|en|measure of location}}
* {{l|en|extremum}}
